claim: The first 64 bits of phi^-1 are 0x9e3779b97f4a7c16
f_definition: f(x)=x*x+B*x-B*B; f is strictly increasing for x>=0; positive root=B/phi
conclusion: a-1 < B/phi < a and a-1/2 < B/phi, so a is nearest rounding but first 64 digits are a-1. Book Eq. (7) product and high-half identity are correct.
